generator: Preserved original Python PipelineAtlas, unmodified source. Runtime data are exact retained source bundles.
hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF8 compact JSON, ensure_ascii=false. Node hashes sort native node identifiers first; all other arrays retain the original Python order. Link shape hash excludes numerical sums but numerical totals/trends/samples are asserted separately.

collections.title: Coal · reported domestic state flows
collections.description: U.S. state/region origins to destination states, with original consuming sector, transport mode and quarter.
collections.time_semantics: Actual annual source ledgers 2020–2024. Original quarterly rows are summed only within explicitly selected dimensions. Missing years are not interpolated.
collections.geographic_scope: U.S. state/region origins to domestic destination states

collections.title: Coal · reported deliveries to Virginia plants
collections.description: Source-facility to receiving-plant monthly coal receipt records. The source can be a mine, loadout, preparation plant or blending terminal.
collections.time_semantics: Actual monthly source receipt records aggregated within selected annual source year. No missing period is interpolated.
collections.geographic_scope: Reported source facilities to Virginia receiving plants

collections.title: Coal · U.S. customs ports to countries
collections.description: Published 2024 cumulative HS6 port-country records for coal, lignite and coke classes. Vessel gross shipping weight and total export value have separate source disclosure boundaries.
collections.time_semantics: One actual complete-calendar-year cumulative source snapshot: December2024 YTD, from Jan–Dec2024. No missing annual frame is inferred.
collections.geographic_scope: Published U.S. customs ports to Census partner areas; exact HS6 classes2701/2702/2704

collections.title: Coal · international customs exports
collections.description: A selected exporter/product/year customs panel. Statistical partner connections, not actual routes or identified factory shipments.
collections.time_semantics: 2024 annual exports; reporter and classification H6 retained; no absent-data zero
collections.geographic_scope: Selected country reporter and all returned partner areas; not a worldwide-complete trade panel

collections.geographic_scope: 80 economies plus rest of world; monetary accounts, not physical routes
